{{External|rs|rsc=Medium Adamantite Helmet}} {{Otheruses|def=no|other uses|Adamant helm (disambiguation)}} {{Infobox Item |name = Adamant med helm |image = [[File:Adamant med helm.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A medium sized helmet. |value = 1920 |weight = 2.267 |exchange = Yes |id = 1145 }} [[File:Adamant med helm detail.png|left|130px]] [[File:Adamant med helm chathead.png|left]] The '''adamant med helm''' is a [[medium helmet]] made of [[adamant equipment|adamantite]]. This helm requires 30 [[Defence]] to wear. It provides more protection than its [[mithril med helm|mithril]] counterpart. It can be made at level 73 [[Smithing]] using an [[adamantite bar]], granting 62.5 [[experience]]. Though the helmet provides a smaller Defence bonus than that of an [[adamant full helm]], it has a lower penalty to [[Magic]] and [[Ranged]] attack. This means it is potentially more useful than the full helm to players who are training the Magic skill. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = +0 |aslash = +0 |acrush = +0 |amagic = -3 |arange = 0 |dstab = +14 |dslash = +15 |dcrush = +13 |dmagic = -1 |drange = +14 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = head |image = [[File:Adamant med helm equipped.png|130px]] |altimage = [[File:Adamant med helm equipped female.png|130px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 73 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 62.5 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Adamantite bar |output1 = Adamant med helm }} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Adamant med helm}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Adamant med helm}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Adamant med helm}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The medium helmet's ranged attack bonus has been increased from -1 to 0. }} {{Subject changes |date = 17 July 2007 |update = Game Improvements (July 2007) |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Adamant med helm detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Adamant med helm detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Adamant med helm (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Adamant med helm.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
